text: [curious] Bangladesh earned thirty-eight point seven billion dollars from garments last year. Want your share? Three steps.
One: register. Trade licence, e-TIN, BIN, then your Export Registration Certificate, the ERC.
Two: join BGMEA for woven or BKMEA for knit. Members get the UD to use bonded fabric.
Three: pass the buyer's compliance audit, then win orders with samples and a safe LC.
Then list your factory on Exportain, and let global buyers find you.
